patterns.note: Asymmetrical, multi-column layouts within sections, often pairing large, bold text with complex product UI mockups or illustrative elements.
A clear typographic hierarchy with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for main sections, supported by smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
A brand palette centered on deep blues/purples and white, accented by vibrant, almost pastel secondary colors (light green, pink, light blue) used in illustrations and interactive elements.

A sticky header navigation remains visible on scroll. Sections below the hero appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport. The hero section itself features a complex, layered product UI illustration that likely incorporates subtle animations or video elements.
Extensive use of product UI mockups and editor screenshots integrated directly into section designs, serving both as visual elements and demonstrations of functionality.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations to reveal content sections. As a user scrolls, elements within a section (text, images, cards) fade in and subtly slide upwards from the bottom, creating a staggered reveal effect, likely using css-keyframes. The main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport on scroll, likely shrinking slightly and gaining a solid background for improved readability. The hero section likely uses video-hero, canvas, or lottie for its dynamic editor UI demonstration.

Product mockups and illustrative elements are frequently integrated into section backgrounds or as floating overlays, often with soft shadows and gradients, to showcase the platform's capabilities in context.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (~4-5x body text) with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, regular-weight body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded corners (e.g., 8-16px) on buttons, cards, and UI elements, contributing to a friendly yet professional feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced padding within content blocks, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's distinctive integration of its own product UI (the Wix editor) as a central visual and interactive element throughout the page, rather than just static screenshots. This creates a highly immersive and demonstrative experience, showcasing the platform's capabilities directly within the design.
